concerns.text: The success criteria SC-006 (≥ 70 % of HCP subjects successfully matched to MER scores) and SC-007 (≥ 95 % of matched subjects have all required network metrics) are unrealistic given the current verified open datasets, which contain **zero** paired fMRI‑MER records. As a result the pipeline will always abort at the validation gate, making the primary research question untestable without a spec revision. The criteria should be relaxed or made conditional on data availability, otherwise the plan is methodologically dead‑ended.
